satellite_ablation_diagnostic.finding: Satellite platform is excluded from the primary model because its current distribution is confounded with source provenance in the corpus (flaring is 54% NOAA-20, wildfire is 13% NOAA-20).

event_dominance_analysis.finding: Cedar Creek represents 695 / 834 (83.33%) of all test wildfire observations and 80.35% of all test observations. Thus, observation-level metrics are heavily weighted toward Cedar Creek plume characteristics, underscoring why event-level metrics (mean probability aggregation) are mandatory.
